name: Emerald Cove Sea Caves & Bioluminescent Grottoes
concierge_tips: Best illuminated between 9:30 AM and 11:30 AM when sunlight strikes the subterranean water caverns. The resort beach club provides complimentary dry bags and water booties.

name: Monte Azure Cliffside Botanical Gardens & Sculpture Walk
concierge_tips: Pick up an iced hibiscus infusion from the garden pavilion tea house. Lower terraces are fully paved and stroller-friendly.

name: Palazzo Bellini Contemporary Maritime Art Museum
transit_options: Complimentary Shuttle to Old Town Gate
concierge_tips: Present your Grand Azure room key at the ticket desk for VIP express admission and complimentary exhibition catalogues.

name: Trattoria Del Porto
operating_hours: Lunch: 12:00 PM - 3:00 PM, Dinner: 6:30 PM - 11:00 PM
highlights: Handmade squid ink tagliolini with lobster
concierge_tips: Ask for Table 12 on the waterside pier to watch classic wooden fishing sloops return at golden hour. Concierge holds nightly priority reservations.

name: Osteria Bella Vista & Wine Cellar
operating_hours: Dinner: 6:00 PM - 10:30 PM Tuesday through Sunday
concierge_tips: Opt for the chef's 5-course regional olive oil and wine tasting pairing menu.

name: Café des Pêcheurs & Oyster Bar
highlights: Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice
concierge_tips: No reservations required; perfect for an unhurried, sun-drenched coastal lunch in linen shirts and sunglasses.

name: Old Town Artisan Crafts & Perfume Ateliers
concierge_tips: Visit Maison de l'Orangerie on Rue des Oliviers for private custom perfume formulation bottled in etched crystal.
address_or_area: Rue des Oliviers & Via degli Artigiani, Citadel District

name: Azure Marina Luxury Fashion Promenade
concierge_tips: Private after-hours VIP salon appointments can be arranged exclusively by Concierge Julian.

name: Resort Electric Hop-On Coastal Shuttle
operating_hours: Every 30 minutes from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM Daily
highlights: Stops at Marina Promenade and Old Town Gate
concierge_tips: Hop on at the main entrance; no ticket needed, simply display your room keycard.

name: Azure Private Fleet & Chauffeur Services
highlights: Chilled San Pellegrino and fresh towels onboard
Flight tracking and airport gate escort
concierge_tips: Reserve 2 hours in advance for local hops or 24 hours for full-day regional touring.

name: Isola Bella High-Speed Catamaran Ferry
operating_hours: Hourly departures between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM
concierge_tips: Buy round-trip tickets from the concierge desk to avoid queues at the marina terminal.

name: St. Nicholas 17th-Century Fortress & Old Town Citadel
concierge_tips: Climb the ramparts at 6:00 PM for the golden hour cannon ceremony over the azure bay.
address_or_area: Piazza della Fortezza, Old Town Citadel

name: Pebble Cove Cliffside Lookout & Secret Sunsets
concierge_tips: Ask Julian to prepare an insulated wicker sunset picnic basket with chilled champagne and artisan cheeses.

name: Sunset Catamaran Sailing & Snorkel Safari
transit_options: Resort Beach Club Dock or Marina Pier
operating_hours: Excursions depart at 10:00 AM and 4:30 PM
highlights: Open champagne bar and gourmet tapas
concierge_tips: The 4:30 PM sunset cruise includes a toast with prosecco as the sun sinks beneath the sea caves.

name: Guided Tuscan & Coastal Wine Tasting Masterclass
highlights: Tasting of 6 reserve vintages with cured prosciutto and pecorino
concierge_tips: We arrange door-to-door round-trip chauffeur so you can savor the wines without driving concerns.

name: Coastal E-Bike Scenic Cliff Trail Tour
highlights: Pre-loaded GPS routes along scenic coastal trails
Helmets, water bottles, and panniers included
concierge_tips: Take the 'Lighthouse Route' (14 km round-trip) featuring gentle paved paths and secluded swim coves.
